title: d__f
description: Inspired by Delta Force, this mod adds tactical items like Sonic Traps, Grenades, and Golden Flowers with unique mechanics to Minecraft.
body:
# d__f ## Introduction Inspired by *Delta Force*, this mod adds a series of functional items that fit seamlessly into the vanilla Minecraft style. Each item features unique mechanics, recipes, and effects to enrich your survival adventure. ## Current Content - **Golden Flower**：Grants buffs on right-click, with effects extended by killing mobs. - **Sonic Trap**：Remains stationary after placement, dealing armor-piercing damage and slowness to creatures that touch it, and triggering chain removal of nearby traps. - **Grenade**: Nothing to say - ...... *Some item names are machine-translated* ## Version Support - Minecraft **1.21 / 1.21.1 / 1.21.11 Fabric** - Minecraft **1.20.1 Forge** ## Languages
Languages

- EN
